description.content: Login attempts share email/IP, email-global and IP-only budgets before password verification. Exhausting any budget returns RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After in seconds. The email-global budget can block a correct password for the remaining window; it has no password exemption.
Authenticates the stored session using database time for its expiry decision.
Replaces the model's capabilities (the operator's edit, O8). The edit survives later syncs, and one that would break a role still pinned to the model is refused with LLM_MODEL_CAPABILITY_MISMATCH.
Creates the organization, then provisions it in ragx synchronously. Always 201 once the row exists; ragxStatus is ready, or failed with ragxErrorCode when ragx refused or was unreachable.
Saves the change. A ready org is synced to ragx at once; if that fails it stays ready with settingsSynced false and ragxErrorCode set. Other states only save the row; provision sends it later.
Provisions (or re-syncs) the org in ragx synchronously from pending, failed or ready; answers its real state.
Core's chat roles for the org, in Settings order, with the org override and what a run would use.
Overrides the role's model for this org. Only core's chat roles; embedding and rerank belong to ragx.
Clears the org's override; idempotent. The org then inherits the platform model.

The org's conversations, most recently updated first, one cursor page at a time. Send the previous response's meta.page.cursor to get the next page; a null cursor marks the last page. Every row has lines ["kb"] because every Agent has one KB. A conversation only exists after a chat (M2b), so this request is not part of the API collection's run yet.
Opaque cursor from the previous page.
Page size, 1 to 100; the default is CORE_CONVERSATION_PAGE_DEFAULT_LIMIT (30).

The conversation with its chat scope and every stored message in UIMessage shape. M2b: the collection has no conversation to read until the chat request creates one. Another org's id, and a malformed one, are CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND.
Renames the conversation (trimmed, 1 to 200 characters). M2b - runs once the chat request has created a conversation.
Deletes the conversation with its messages and runs. M2b - runs once the chat request has created a conversation.

item.name: Read from the ragx app through the proxy

request.name: Read from the ragx app through the proxy

description.content: Generic proxy to ragx's /v1 API (spec ragx-custom-app §14.2). Core does not know ragx's routes: it signs a 60-second App token for the org in the path (scope kb:read for GET/HEAD, kb:write otherwise) and forwards the body, Content-Type, Idempotency-Key, Accept-Language and X-Request-Id only. Ragx 2xx and catalog 4xx come back verbatim; a route that needs another scope is 404; ragx 401, 5xx, timeouts and oversized bodies are 503.
(Required) Ragx path below /v1 (may contain "/"); ^[A-Za-z0-9._~/-]+$, no "..", no "//", no trailing "/".

All responses use the shared response format {data, meta} or {error}. Error codes come from contracts/errors.yaml. JSON request bodies require application/json (charset parameters are supported). Missing, malformed or other media types return UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE (415). Unknown fields and malformed JSON return VALIDATION_FAILED (400). Requiring JSON and rejecting unknown fields are breaking changes for callers that previously relied on permissive decoding.
